name: What does interior water damage repair actually include?
description: It usually includes inspection, drying, cleanup, and rebuilding damaged drywall, flooring, trim, and other interior finishes after the leak is controlled.

mainEntity.name: What does interior water damage repair actually include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, water damage interior repair typically covers wet drywall, ceilings, flooring, trim, insulation, and other affected finishes after the source is controlled and the area is dried. A proper job usually includes inspection, moisture testing, drying, cleanup, repair coordination, and rebuilding damaged interior surfaces.
